function.name: remember_note
function.description: Save something the user wants remembered for later, e.g. 'remember my locker is 42', 'remember I parked on level 3'

text.description: the fact to remember, in the user's words

function.name: recall_note
function.description: Look up something the user asked you to remember earlier, e.g. 'where is my locker', 'what did I tell you about the car', 'what was my locker number'

topic.description: the thing being asked about, e.g. 'locker'

function.name: set_timer
function.description: Start a countdown timer or alarm, e.g. 'set a timer for 5 minutes', 'wake me up in 10 minutes'

function.name: where_am_i
function.description: Show the user's own current position on the offline map, e.g. 'where am I', 'show me where I am', 'I am lost'

function.name: navigate_to
function.description: Walking directions to a named place, e.g. 'take me to the Frauenkirche', 'how do I get to the station'

function.name: take_photo
function.description: Just take a photo, e.g. 'take a picture', 'snap a photo'

function.name: describe_photo
function.description: Look through the camera and say what something is, e.g. 'what is this', 'what am I looking at', 'can you see this', 'what is in front of me'

function.name: dance
function.description: The character dances or does a trick, e.g. 'dance', 'do a little dance'

function.name: answer_question
function.description: Answer a general question about facts, places or Dresden, e.g. 'how old is the Frauenkirche', 'what is the Zwinger'
